note: Every requirement stated in instruction.md or /instructions/ maps to at least one judge criterion, and every judge criterion traces back to a stated requirement. Criteria are addressed as <dimension>/<criterion_id>. A dimension is a directory under tests/ and may hold several judge TOML files. Stub judge.toml files next to judge_*.toml are not scored.
reward: render and constraints are gates: if either scores below 1.0 the reward is 0. Otherwise reward = 0.6 * functional + 0.4 * polish.

dimensions.render: Liveness gate, 1 criterion: default Avery session on a DrawBill surface. Deliberately thin because it hard-zeroes the run.
dimensions.constraints: Access gate, 3 criteria over 1 session: the books are named as SQLite on a surface of the product's own, they are written on the server rather than in the page (a paper created through the UI is read back after a reload), and no desk token is served to the browser. Deliberately small - with render this is the whole of the hard gate - but it carries one behavioural check on purpose, because a gate with no server-backed tooth is cleared by a hardcoded mock. Restart durability, unknown identities, composition, certify, release, card payment, desks and roles are graded in functional, where a miss costs part of the reward instead of the run. Where the ledger sits on disk is a storage contract the verifier's own reset honours (it removes /app/data and any stray *.db before a fresh group), not a string any criterion asks the product to publish.
dimensions.functional: Product behaviour, 65 criteria over 13 sessions, including the restart session that grades the books coming back off disk and the unknown-identity refusal: four seeded jobs and plant tickets; live desks asked at quote and again at pay; mill index, owner encumbrance, DBE participation, and payroll/COI gates; joint-check payees; withdraw of an uncertified pencil; Harborview April line items; file/certify/release roles; paid notices, posted breakdown and certify-time then paid waivers; Downtown first paper and abandoned Checkout; Riverwalk negative net and refused Checkout; Avery cannot file Westfork; period gates; forged payloads; role and staff isolation. Write/composition sessions weight 2.0; seed session weight 1.0.
dimensions.polish: 8 criteria over 2 sessions: live quote before the card, product health surface, refusals visible on screen, staff actions reachable by intent, composition lines legible, identity switcher usable, Checkout return posted, APP_MANIFEST.md served at GET /APP_MANIFEST.md documenting identity/endpoints/SQLite.

requirements.requirement: One Node process serves the UI and API on port 3000 with Express, SQLite via node:sqlite, and the plant's card desk.

SQLite is the ledger at /app/data/drawbill.db; seed JSON is copied into /app and loaded on first boot; pennies in the books, whole dollars in artifacts; data survives a process restart and seeding does not run twice.
Plant desk tokens stay on the server and out of browser code.
A fresh browser is already Avery Lin with no login; a visible switcher changes seeded identity.
An unknown identity is turned away and does not become Avery; a request with no identity is Avery.
Four seeded jobs load and can be told apart, including Westfork Clinic TI. Avery can see Westfork and cannot file an owner paper on it.
Harborview SOV shows the five seeded lines with tags, originals and unit rates.
A job can be opened from catalog fields without using the marketing title Harborview.
Downtown and Riverwalk profiles carry their own originals, county windows and SOV tags.
Plant file shows Diego's Harborview tickets, Casey's receiving ticket, executed CO-01, draft CO-02, Ironclad's sub-invoice, payroll stamps, insurance expiry, and the foundation inspection stamp.
The till asks the live plant desks at quote time rather than remembering percentages.

Composition desks (tax, retainage, fee) are asked again when the card desk says paid, and the four after-pay destinations named in integration-copy.md — paper, SMS and email receipts plus the diary hold — receive the paid figures. Waivers are covered separately by PAY-03 and the member punch by PAY-02.
A client-supplied Downtown tax window does not steer Harborview's county desk.
Harborview April payees include both Northline Construction and Ironclad Steel on one card amount.
The mill extra is forty thousand because the index desk already knows it; a typed amount that does not match the index is not an extra.

The permit / inspection desk decides the gate on permit-gated lines; the till does not keep that rule to itself. Harborview 03-400 superstructure stays at zero until foundations are complete and stamped.
The architect e-stamp desk stamps a certified paper; the till may not stamp it in its own tables.
The till may not invent remaining owner encumbrance; a positive-net quote asks the encumbrance desk.
Harborview's Horizon deck line asks the DBE desk; Downtown has no participation line and must still compose.
Certified payroll and COI are desk-owned; composing a paper asks those desks rather than only displaying plant-file stamps.
An uncertified Downtown pencil can be withdrawn and the period typed again; a certified, released, or paid paper cannot.
This-period work is current billed-to-date minus the last posted snapshot; stored and converted piles are distinguished.
Fee is dual-rate: original this-period work at eight, executed extras at six, general conditions excluded.
County tax is a single line on this-period work in place only; stored, fee, bond, retainage, fringe and damages are not a tax base.
Harborview April retainage splits: stepped-down twentieth on WIP, tenth on new stored, converted not retained again, GC excluded.
April Harborview fringe rider sits on the card total and is not folded into tax, fee or retainage bases.
Bond is once on the first posted paper; Harborview April carries $0.00 bond.
Harborview April carries $0.00 damages with a Riverwalk positive control.
Avery can file Harborview App 2 for 2030-04-01 through 2030-04-30.
Only Samira certifies the exact composed net; Avery's certify is refused.
Victor releases Harborview to the rail; Samira cannot release; Victor cannot mint Checkout.
Avery pays Harborview App 2 via hosted Checkout at $287,755.00 and the paper posts.
After pay, paper/SMS/email copies, diary and punch match the card desk; Chris stays empty.
Conditional waivers exist once Samira has certified, before the card clears; after pay, unconditional waivers wait on Ruth.
Replaying confirm does not duplicate the posted row or notices.
Downtown April composes its own net and first-paper profile (bond, Downtown tax, full tenth).
Downtown Checkout is opened then abandoned; nothing posts and the period stays open.
A fabricated Checkout session id is refused with a 4xx and writes nothing.
Riverwalk 2030-04-01..04-10 composes negative through damages net of weather days.
A negative Riverwalk net refuses Checkout; Owen Park releases, not Victor.
Seeded Harborview March App 1 stays posted and is not collected again.
Inclusive overlap on the same job is refused; two jobs sharing April is not overlap.
Books are not open before 2030-03-01; June 25-30 blackout refuses; slash and timestamp dates refuse.
Client-supplied net, tax window, rates and fabricated SOV lines do not move the composed figures.
Samira stamps the composed net: a penny-off proposed amount is refused, or ignored so the certified net stays the composed figure.

Chris cannot read Northline papers after pay; each sub PM reads their own line and only their own line — Marcus sees 03-200 and not 03-100, Lena sees 03-300 and not 03-200; and Westfork's PM does not see Northline's Harborview books.
A role name typed onto a request is not a promotion.
Jonah can file a pencil and cannot pay; Priya stays in pencil; Lena and Wei cannot pay or file owner papers they are not for.
A paper's own state gates the ladder: an uncertified pencil cannot be released, and an unreleased paper cannot mint a card session.
Ruth the notary does not file pay applications; Avery does.
Casey cannot certify; Harper is read-only; Diego/Helen cannot file or certify owner paper; Avery cannot notarize while Ruth can; Chris has an empty file.
APP_MANIFEST.md documents how demo identity works, the main HTTP endpoints, and how SQLite is reached, and the app serves that same file at GET /APP_MANIFEST.md.
A live quote before the card shows the composed net; each composition line is readable, not just the net.
The product exposes its own status surface that reports the app is up. The ledger engine is named on that surface or in chrome.
Turned-down payment or certify is visible on screen with a reason; file/certify/release Harborview App 2 are reachable by intent.
